Class OptionsSwitch

    • read

      public Object read(JsonParser parser)
      Description copied from interface: IuJsonAdapter
      Reads a JSON value from a parser and converts it to its Java equivalent.

      parser must be positioned at the value's first event: START_OBJECT, START_ARRAY, or a scalar value event. On return, parser is positioned at the value's last event: the matching END_OBJECT or END_ARRAY, or the scalar value event itself. This is the contract of JsonParser.getValue(), which the default implementation delegates to.

      Specified by:
      read in interface IuJsonAdapter<Object>
      Parameters:
      parser - JSON parser
      Returns:
      Java equivalent

    • write

      public void write(Object value, JsonGenerator generator)
      Description copied from interface: IuJsonAdapter
      Converts a value to its JSON equivalent and writes it to a generator.

      Writes exactly one JSON value in the generator's current context; in an object context, the caller writes the key first with JsonGenerator.writeKey(String).
